tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: Window background, header bars and toolbars. The ground most controls sit on.

tokens.name: view
tokens.usage: Content areas inside a window: file lists, documents, terminal, text views.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Navigation sidebars. One tone away from `window`, separated by a `line` hairline.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards and boxed lists on `window`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs inside apps.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Resting fill of buttons, toggles and the selected segment. Always with a `line` border.

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: Button fill under the pointer, together with an `accent` border.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Text fields, checkboxes and radios. Bordered with `line-strong`.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed troughs, darker than the window in both themes: slider and progress tracks, the segmented control's bed, switches that are off.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Overlay on flat items under the pointer: list rows, bar items, flat buttons. Also the resting disc of the window buttons.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Overlay on flat items while pressed or held open.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: button and card outlines, separators between header bar and content, list dividers. Decorative; never the only sign of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of controls whose edge is their only shape: text fields, checkboxes, radios, switches that are off. 3:1 on `window`, `view`, `card` and `field`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `window`, `view`, `sidebar`, `card`, `popover`, `control` and `shell`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: row subtitles, captions, shortcuts, placeholder text. On `window`, `view`, `sidebar`, `card`, `popover` and `shell`.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only. Below 4.5:1 on purpose; never for text someone needs to read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The accent in use: holly unless the person picked another. Suggested buttons, switches that are on, slider fill, the selection border, hover and focus outlines, the focused-window ring. `data-accent="NAME"` points this and its four companions at the `accent-NAME` set.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: An `accent` fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text and icons: links, the active item in a menu bar. On `window`, `view`, `sidebar`, `card` and `popover`.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selection fill, always paired with a 1px `accent` border. Text on it stays `ink`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` or `accent-hover` fill. Dark in the dark theme, where the accent is light.

tokens.name: accent-holly
tokens.usage: Accent choice: Holly green, the default. The plain `accent` tokens hold the same values. Pairs with the Holly wallpaper.

tokens.name: accent-holly-hover
tokens.usage: The `accent-holly` fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-holly-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the `accent-holly` colour on neutral grounds.

tokens.name: accent-holly-tint
tokens.usage: Selection fill of the `accent-holly` set.

tokens.name: on-accent-holly
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent-holly` fill.

tokens.name: accent-berry
tokens.usage: Accent choice: Berry red. A suggested button then has the colour of a destructive one, so dialogs keep the safe action first and name the result in the label.

tokens.name: accent-berry-hover
tokens.usage: The `accent-berry` fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-berry-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the `accent-berry` colour on neutral grounds.

tokens.name: accent-berry-tint
tokens.usage: Selection fill of the `accent-berry` set.

tokens.name: on-accent-berry
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent-berry` fill.

tokens.name: accent-sky
tokens.usage: Accent choice: Sky blue, the blue both Adwaita and Breeze start from. Pairs with the Frost wallpaper.

tokens.name: accent-sky-hover
tokens.usage: The `accent-sky` fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-sky-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the `accent-sky` colour on neutral grounds.

tokens.name: accent-sky-tint
tokens.usage: Selection fill of the `accent-sky` set.

tokens.name: on-accent-sky
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent-sky` fill.

tokens.name: accent-teal
tokens.usage: Accent choice: Teal. Close to `success-ink`, which always comes with its icon. Pairs with the Tide wallpaper.

tokens.name: accent-teal-hover
tokens.usage: The `accent-teal` fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-teal-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the `accent-teal` colour on neutral grounds.

tokens.name: accent-teal-tint
tokens.usage: Selection fill of the `accent-teal` set.

tokens.name: on-accent-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent-teal` fill.

tokens.name: accent-plum
tokens.usage: Accent choice: Plum. Pairs with the Dusk wallpaper.

tokens.name: accent-plum-hover
tokens.usage: The `accent-plum` fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-plum-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the `accent-plum` colour on neutral grounds.

tokens.name: accent-plum-tint
tokens.usage: Selection fill of the `accent-plum` set.

tokens.name: on-accent-plum
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent-plum` fill.

tokens.name: accent-amber
tokens.usage: Accent choice: Amber. Close to `warning-ink`, which always comes with its icon. Pairs with the Ember wallpaper.

tokens.name: accent-amber-hover
tokens.usage: The `accent-amber` fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-amber-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the `accent-amber` colour on neutral grounds.

tokens.name: accent-amber-tint
tokens.usage: Selection fill of the `accent-amber` set.

tokens.name: on-accent-amber
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent-amber` fill.

tokens.name: accent-slate
tokens.usage: Accent choice: Slate, for people who want no colour. Pairs with the Slate wallpaper.

tokens.name: accent-slate-hover
tokens.usage: The `accent-slate` fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-slate-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the `accent-slate` colour on neutral grounds.

tokens.name: accent-slate-tint
tokens.usage: Selection fill of the `accent-slate` set.

tokens.name: on-accent-slate
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent-slate` fill.

tokens.name: berry
tokens.usage: Berry, the second brand colour. Destructive buttons, the window close button under the pointer, unread counts, error marks.

tokens.name: berry-ink
tokens.usage: Berry-coloured text and icons on `window`, `view`, `card`, `popover` and `berry-tint`.

tokens.name: berry-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of error banners, bordered with `berry`.

tokens.name: on-berry
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `berry` fill.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success text, icons and banner border. Teal, not green: it stays apart from `berry` for red-green colour blindness and from the holly accent. Always with a check icon or a word.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of success banners.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text, icons and banner border. Always with the warning triangle or a word.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of warning banners.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Informational text, icons and banner border.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of informational banners.

tokens.name: shell
tokens.usage: Translucent fill of panels that carry body text and may lie over any window: launcher, control centre, notifications, menus, the switcher, the on-screen display. Higher than `shell-thin` so `ink-muted` stays readable.

tokens.name: shell-thin
tokens.usage: Translucent fill of the bar and the dock, over the blurred, saturated backdrop. Only `ink` text and icons sit on it, never `ink-muted` text. Turns into `shell-solid` when the transparency setting or a maximised window calls for it.

tokens.name: shell-solid
tokens.usage: The opaque shell fill: every shell surface with transparency set to Opaque, the bar and dock while a window is maximised in Adaptive, and any surface the contrast floor has raised all the way.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim behind modal dialogs and over the desktop in the overview and the launcher.

tokens.name: holly-900
tokens.usage: Brand ramp, darkest. Wallpaper ground, lock screen, the dark block on the cover. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: holly-700
tokens.usage: Brand ramp. Wallpaper leaves, deep brand fields.

tokens.name: holly-500
tokens.usage: Brand ramp, the holly green of the mark. Equal to `accent` in the light theme.

tokens.name: holly-300
tokens.usage: Brand ramp. Wallpaper highlights, illustration.

tokens.name: holly-100
tokens.usage: Brand ramp, lightest. Light wallpaper ground, tinted brand fields.

tokens.name: berry-500
tokens.usage: The berry red of the mark and wallpaper. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: swatch-holly
tokens.usage: Fixed tile colour for placeholder app icons. The `swatch-*` colours never change with the theme or the accent and take white symbols. The accent choices are the `accent-NAME` sets.

tokens.name: swatch-berry
tokens.usage: Fixed tile colour for placeholder app icons.

tokens.name: swatch-sky
tokens.usage: Fixed tile colour for placeholder app icons.

tokens.name: swatch-teal
tokens.usage: Fixed tile colour for placeholder app icons: the web browser.

tokens.name: swatch-plum
tokens.usage: Fixed tile colour for placeholder app icons.

tokens.name: swatch-amber
tokens.usage: Fixed tile colour for placeholder app icons.

tokens.name: swatch-slate
tokens.usage: Fixed tile colour for placeholder app icons: system apps, the launcher, the trash.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque, for the few large moments: the lock-screen clock, first-run and installer titles.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The lock-screen and greeter clock. Tabular figures.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: First-run and installer titles. One per screen.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Titles of full-screen states and status pages.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Hanken Grotesk. 14px body: between Breeze's 10pt and Adwaita's 11pt.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Header-bar titles and group headings above a boxed list.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A new ilex image is downloaded and applies on the next restart.
styles.usage: Everything else: labels, rows, menus, body copy.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, the focused app's name in the top bar, notification titles.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels in sidebars and the control centre.

styles.name: bar
styles.usage: Top-bar text. Tabular figures so the clock does not shift.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Terminal, image references, digests, key caps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The grid unit. Gap between an icon and its label in dense rows, padding inside menus.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; the gap between tiled windows and the screen edge.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons, rows and fields; padding of shell popovers.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between groups in a form.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page margins inside a window; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a settings page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Margins of full-screen states: lock screen, first run, overview.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, key caps, menu items, the segment inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Windows, buttons, fields, sidebar and dock highlights. Breeze's shape: its frames are 5px.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, boxed lists, menus, dialogs, notifications, quick-setting tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Shell surfaces only: the dock, the launcher, the control centre.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switches, search fields, badges, the on-screen display.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Buttons and the selected segment: just enough to lift them off `window`.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the dock, notifications: a 1px outline and a short shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: The focused window in classic mode, dialogs, the launcher. Breeze's window outline with a compact shadow; never a wide soft glow.

tokens.name: shadow-window-idle
tokens.usage: Unfocused windows in classic mode; every tiled window in scrolling mode.

size.note: Fixed dimensions of the shell and of controls.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar.

tokens.name: titlebar-height
tokens.usage: Title bar of a window. Breeze's is 30px; Adwaita's header bar is 47px.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, sidebar items, menu-bar popovers' rows.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons in header bars and notifications.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a boxed-list row and of a launcher result.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Symbolic icons. 20px in the launcher field, 22px on app-icon tiles.

tokens.name: dock-icon
tokens.usage: App-icon tile in the dock.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Navigation sidebar of an app.

tokens.name: window-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between tiled windows and around them in scrolling mode (Hyprland gaps_in half of it, gaps_out all of it).

tokens.name: focus-border
tokens.usage: Width of the focused-window ring in scrolling mode and of keyboard-focus outlines.

tokens.name: shell-blur
tokens.usage: Blur radius behind `shell` surfaces.

effect.note: How a translucent shell surface treats what is behind it. The numbers are KWin's blur defaults, which Plasma uses.

tokens.name: shell-blur-passes
tokens.usage: Dual-Kawase blur: the backdrop is halved this many times, then doubled back. KWin blur strength 15.

tokens.name: shell-blur-offset
tokens.usage: Dual-Kawase sample offset at the deepest pass. KWin blur strength 15.

tokens.name: shell-saturation
tokens.usage: Saturation applied to the blurred backdrop with Rec. 709 luma weights, so colour survives the fill. KWin default 150%.

tokens.name: shell-noise
tokens.usage: Strength of the grey noise added over the blur to hide banding: 5 of 255 levels, KWin's default.

duration.note: Entering takes the full time. Leaving takes 70% of it. Every time is multiplied by the animation speed setting.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Controls: hover, press, focus ring, switch, checkbox, slider knob, selection moving. Also every cross-fade in Reduced.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Things that open from the bar or under the pointer: menus, control centre, notifications, on-screen display, tooltips.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Things with a body: windows opening, closing, snapping and maximising, the strip scrolling, launcher, switcher, dialogs, the dock.

tokens.name: duration-slower
tokens.usage: The whole screen: workspace switch, overview, lock, and cross-fades of style, accent and wallpaper.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entering: fast start, long settle. The default.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Leaving: gathers speed and is gone.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Moving between two resting places: the strip, a workspace, a window being maximised or snapped, the dock docking.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Progress bars and plain opacity fades.
